reviewed_decisions.subject: Text rendering modes as fill/stroke/clip operations
reviewed_decisions.source_check: §9.3.6 physical pp.318-320, footer ISO 32000-2:2020(E), including Table 104 and the special Type 3 and empty-outline text. The rule says outlines accumulate to ET, clip after painting, and an empty accumulation causes no clip.
reviewed_decisions.current_evidence: glyph_painting.rs classifies the independent operations; show.rs records accumulated outlines; end_object.rs creates a nonzero clip after the text object's marks. text_render_modes.rs and text_clipping_audit.rs have discriminating mode, empty-path and paint-before-clip controls.
reviewed_decisions.decision: Retain; ADR 0022's core decision is supported by the source and current assertions. This review did not exhaust clipping interactions with all alpha, group or optional-content states.

reviewed_decisions.subject: EC3 #368 discovery and q/Q text matrix restoration
reviewed_decisions.source_check: EC3 #368 adds to §9.4.2 the requirement that q/Q within a text object additionally push/pop Tm and Tlm; the EC3 amendment is recorded in doc/errata-read.md and re-cited in the ledger. Base §9.4.1 is physical pp.321-322 (printed pp.306-307); §9.4.2 is physical pp.322-324 (printed pp.307-309).
reviewed_decisions.current_evidence: run/graphics.rs stores/restores the two text matrices together with graphics state, while in a text object. text_state.rs::q_and_q_save_the_text_matrices_inside_a_text_object and text_positioning_audit.rs::q_restore_recovers_the_line_matrix_used_by_the_next_line_operator distinguish saved vs unsaved outcomes.
reviewed_decisions.decision: Retain the source interpretation and implementation decision. Correct the ledger mapping: neither §9.4.1 nor §9.4.2 test arrays currently name these focused assertions, despite their notes discussing #368. ADR 0421's rationale is not a substitute for current test execution.

reviewed_decisions.subject: Rechecking text-positioning errata and q/Q corpus claim
reviewed_decisions.source_check: EC3 #373 changes Table 106's T* expansion token TD to Td; Table 106's base physical page 323/printed p.308 says Tm operands replace rather than concatenate. #368 is a separate addition to the same subclause.
reviewed_decisions.current_evidence: text_ops.rs implements T* by translating Tlm and copying it to Tm, so its arithmetic matches the amended form. text_positioning_audit.rs checks T* against an explicit placement, and the q/Q test checks a synthetic valid pair. The ledger row's test list omits the focused tests it discusses.
reviewed_decisions.decision: The reviewed ADR distinction between valid producer behavior and damaged-stream corpus examples is sound. The physical test evidence supports the operator semantics; ledger evidence names need repair outside this shard.

reviewed_decisions.subject: EC3 #376 normalization and Trm note status
reviewed_decisions.source_check: §9.3.4 physical p.317 (printed p.302) has the #376 annotation marker and amended percentage/normalized-factor wording; §9.4.4 physical p.326 (printed p.311) marks NOTE 2 to be made normative. EC3 statement and errata-read.md identify both changes.
reviewed_decisions.current_evidence: text_ops.rs divides Tz by 100; glyph_to_text applies horizontal scale to x; advance_step and the TJ branch scale horizontal movement only. Current horizontal and vertical tests discriminate Tc, TJ, shape and vertical displacement behavior.
reviewed_decisions.decision: Retain. No conflict found between the amended rule and current code. Note that the 9.3.4 ledger tests do not directly assert horizontal outline extent, although the vertical-font test directly asserts extent under Tz=50.

reviewed_decisions.subject: Text-space word-gap inference
reviewed_decisions.source_check: §9.4.4 physical pp.325-326 specifies the displacement computation; it does not prescribe thresholds for inferred readback word breaks.
reviewed_decisions.current_evidence: This shard did not re-audit separate_text or inferred word gaps. Those are an extraction/readback policy with ADR 1490, separate from the explicit Tw glyph-advance rule in §9.3.3 and numeric TJ positioning in §9.4.3.
reviewed_decisions.decision: Keep outside this audit's verdict. Do not use ADR 1490 to establish conformance or nonconformance of Tw/TJ operator movement.

ledger_corrections_to_consider.issue: Current note says no writing mode 1 exists; this conflicts with §9.3.2's explicit vertical displacement language and vertical font support. Add the vertical-spacing test to evidence list and remove the claim.

The dedicated q/Q and positioning audit tests are absent from the listed test arrays although the note claims the assertions. Name tests by owner and verify there is no 9.4.1/9.4.2 evidence-placement drift.
No listed direct assertion was found for a numeric TJ adjustment under a vertical writing font. Existing vertical default advance tests do not prove TJ's vertical branch.
